configurePresets.name: base
configurePresets.description: Ninja, a build tree named after the preset, a compilation database for the language server, the host codecs, and any compiler launchers the environment names, like CMAKE_CXX_COMPILER_LAUNCHER=ccache. Pin the compiler path or UFORM_CUDA_ARCHITECTURES of one machine in a CMakeUserPresets.json on top.

configurePresets.name: debug
configurePresets.displayName: Debug - unoptimized host code
configurePresets.description: Unoptimized host code with full DWARF, every host library, tool and suite.

configurePresets.name: check
configurePresets.displayName: Check - fastest compile cycle
configurePresets.description: Does it still compile, nothing more: -O0 without debug information on the host, and in ptxas where CUDA is added, with warnings as errors.

configurePresets.name: relwithdebinfo
configurePresets.displayName: RelWithDebInfo - optimized with symbols and device line tables
configurePresets.description: Optimized, with host DWARF and -lineinfo device line tables for cuda-gdb and Nsight. The tree `.clangd` reads.

configurePresets.name: release
configurePresets.displayName: Release - every host target
configurePresets.description: The host libraries and the conformance suites, fully optimized.

configurePresets.name: cuda
configurePresets.displayName: CUDA - every target with the NVIDIA residency
configurePresets.description: The release build plus the NVIDIA residency, the trainer, the mesh and the loaders, for the default Turing-through-Blackwell architectures.

configurePresets.name: rocm
configurePresets.displayName: ROCm - every target with the AMD residency
configurePresets.description: The release build plus the AMD residency, its HIP units compiled by ROCm's own Clang.

configurePresets.name: library
configurePresets.displayName: Library - the C library for the host alone
configurePresets.description: The C library alone, fully optimized, without the trainer or the conformance suites.

configurePresets.name: stub_library
configurePresets.displayName: Stub Library - the C headers over a library that reports every verb unsupported

configurePresets.name: swift
configurePresets.displayName: Swift - the XCFramework or artifact bundle SwiftPM links
configurePresets.description: The CPU library packed for SwiftPM, or with UFORM_BUILD_STUB the stand-in the Swift suite runs against. An Apple slice names its SDK and architecture, here or with -D, and any other target its Swift triples in UFORM_SWIFT_TRIPLES.

configurePresets.name: cuda_rocm_library
configurePresets.displayName: CUDA and ROCm Library - the C library with both GPU residencies
configurePresets.description: Clang compiles the host code of both vendors: NVCC hosts on it, and ROCm's own Clang compiles the HIP units.

configurePresets.name: linux_cuda_rocm
configurePresets.displayName: Linux CUDA and ROCm - the inference library with both GPU residencies and no trainer
configurePresets.description: Both vendors' encoder variants in one shared library that links no GPU runtime of its own, which the vendor-boundary check reads with readelf.

configurePresets.name: wasm32_emscripten
configurePresets.displayName: WebAssembly Emscripten - the C library for browsers and Node

configurePresets.name: wasm64_emscripten
configurePresets.displayName: WebAssembly Emscripten 64 - the extended C library for isolated pages and Node

configurePresets.name: wasm32_wasi
configurePresets.displayName: WebAssembly WASI - the C library for standalone runtimes

configurePresets.name: android_arm64
configurePresets.displayName: Android ARM64 - the C library through the NDK's toolchain

configurePresets.name: msvc2026_x64
configurePresets.displayName: Windows x64 - the C library with Visual Studio 2026

configurePresets.name: machine
configurePresets.description: The C library for one machine: its CPU floor and class, only the NumKong capabilities it runs, and its one GPU code.

configurePresets.name: xeon4_hopper
configurePresets.displayName: Xeon 4 with Hopper - compile only

configurePresets.name: xeon6_blackwell
configurePresets.displayName: Xeon 6 with Blackwell - compile only

configurePresets.name: grace_hopper
configurePresets.displayName: Grace with Hopper - compile only
configurePresets.description: Neoverse V2 runs apple_m2 in full, and aws_g5 needs WFET.

configurePresets.name: vera_rubin
configurePresets.displayName: Vera with Rubin - compile only
configurePresets.description: Olympus cores need Clang 22 or GCC 15, and CUDA 13.4 names no Rubin code, so Rubin runs the Blackwell bundle on 100f.
